attr.title: audiofilus
attr.desc: A pixel-art music player with album covers. Keep the music going while you game, or turn the screen off and control it from your pocket.
attr.inst: Ready to run on Knulli, muOS, ROCKNIX, ArkOS and dArkOS. Put your music (MP3, AAC/M4A, ALAC, FLAC, Ogg Vorbis, Opus, WAV, AIFF, MOD/XM/IT) in a folder and pick it on the first run.
